inflows.source: CMS NHE 2023; 2024 Medicare Trustees Report Table II.B1; payroll tax = 2.9% FICA-HI

inflows.source: CMS NHE 2023; 2024 Trustees Report; Part B std premium $164.90/mo (CMS fact sheet)

inflows.source: CMS NHE 2023; Trustees Report; includes interest on trust fund assets + taxation of benefits

outflows.note: 52% of Medicare via MA private plans
outflows.source: MedPAC July 2025 Data Book Sec 1; KFF MA Spending Brief 2024; CMS NHE 2023

outflows.label: Hospital care (FFS inpatient + outpatient) → Hospitals
outflows.source: CMS NHE 2023 Table 7 (hospital by payer); MedPAC Data Book Sec 3

outflows.label: Physician & clinical services (FFS) → Physicians & Clinicians
outflows.source: CMS NHE 2023 Table 8 (physician by payer); MedPAC Data Book Sec 4

split.label: Home health → Long-Term Care

split.label: Hospice → Long-Term Care
